compatibility.not_analyzed: Compatibility has not been analyzed yet for this build.
compatibility.stale: The build, its components, profiles, or associations changed. Results are outdated — analyze again.
compatibility.error: Could not analyze compatibility for this build.
compatibility.not_found: The build no longer exists. Refresh the list and try again.
compatibility.scope_note: The analysis is based on available technical attributes and implemented rules. It does not certify full computer compatibility or replace manufacturer documentation.
compatibility.evidence_disclaimer: The application shows recorded evidence metadata; it does not automatically authenticate documentation or certify manufacturer information.

result_explanations.compatible: The relations evaluated within scope passed with sufficient verified data. This is not a certification of full system compatibility.
result_explanations.incompatible: At least one confirmed technical contradiction was detected.
result_explanations.requires_verification: Some conditions are not sufficiently verified, or there are relations outside the current scope. This is not a confirmed incompatibility.
result_explanations.insufficient_data: Required attributes are missing to reach reliable conclusions.

finding.unknown_message: The analysis produced a finding that cannot be described by the current interface. Technical details are shown below.

not_evaluated_reason.no_rules_implemented: No rules implemented yet for this category.
not_evaluated_reason.physical_dimensions_partial: Only declared length was compared; other physical dimensions/clearances are not evaluated.
not_evaluated_reason.physical_dimensions_not_evaluated: Physical dimensions and clearances are not evaluated.
not_evaluated_reason.thermal_capacity_not_evaluated: Socket match does not evaluate thermal capacity or full mounting/physical compatibility.
not_evaluated_reason.physical_mounting_partial: Only the declared air cooler height was compared; other mounting/clearance aspects are not evaluated.
not_evaluated_reason.physical_mounting_not_evaluated: Physical mounting and clearances are not evaluated.
not_evaluated_reason.radiator_mounting_not_evaluated: Radiator and liquid cooling mounting compatibility are not evaluated.
not_evaluated_reason.m2_topology_and_sata_ports_not_evaluated: M.2 topology, SATA-port sharing/disabling and SATA-interface rules are not evaluated yet.
not_evaluated_reason.m2_topology_not_evaluated: M.2 topology and conditional resource sharing are not evaluated.
not_evaluated_reason.multi_unit_joint_fit_not_demonstrated: Individual M.2 evaluations do not prove simultaneous fit of multiple units without slot assignment.
not_evaluated_reason.bay_free_space_and_adapters_not_evaluate: Free bay space, adapters, trays and mounting positions are not evaluated.
not_evaluated_reason.electrical_power_not_evaluated: Electrical power capacity, wattage margins and transient behavior are not evaluated.
not_evaluated_reason.modular_pinout_and_cable_assignment_not_: Modular connector pinouts, cable assignment and split-cable electrical independence are not evaluated.
not_evaluated_reason.no_power_requirements_present: No motherboard/GPU power-connector requirements are present to evaluate against the PSU inventory.
not_evaluated_reason.storage_controller_and_raid_not_evaluate: SATA/RAID controllers, HBAs, splitters, port multipliers and RAID arrays are not modeled or evaluated.
not_evaluated_reason.sata_port_assignment_and_conditions_not_: Physical SATA port assignment, cable routing, BIOS conditions and exact port usage are not evaluated.
not_evaluated_reason.m2_slot_assignment_and_routing_not_evalu: Physical M.2 slot assignment, PCIe lane routing/availability and performance are not evaluated.
not_evaluated_reason.chipset_platform_not_evaluated: Chipset and platform compatibility are not evaluated.
not_evaluated_reason.power_delivery_not_evaluated: Power delivery and VRM adequacy are not evaluated.
not_evaluated_reason.case_psu_depth_not_evaluated: Declared PSU depth and exact case clearance are not compared.
not_evaluated_reason.case_psu_cable_clearance_not_evaluated: Cable routing space around the PSU is not evaluated.

limitations_tokens.out_of_scope_relations_present: The build contains categories with relations not evaluated by the current engine.
limitations_tokens.no_applicable_rules: No applicable compatibility rules could be evaluated.
limitations_tokens.gpu_geometry_not_fully_evaluated: GPU physical fit is not fully evaluated (height, thickness, slots, power cable clearance, radiator/fan/bay interference, and tolerances are not checked).
limitations_tokens.thermal_performance_not_evaluated: CPU cooling thermal capacity, performance, noise, load behavior, and full mounting details are not evaluated.
limitations_tokens.cooling_physical_mounting_not_fully_eval: Cooling physical mounting is not fully evaluated (radiator support, mounting positions, RAM/VRM/fan/panel interference, and tolerances are not checked).
limitations_tokens.m2_topology_not_fully_evaluated: M.2 topology, SATA-port sharing/disabling and PCIe generation/lane performance are not fully evaluated.
limitations_tokens.multi_m2_joint_fit_not_evaluated: Joint fit of multiple M.2 units is not demonstrated without an assignment model.
limitations_tokens.bay_free_space_not_evaluated: Bay capacity only; free-space availability, adapters and mounting positions are not evaluated.
limitations_tokens.psu_electrical_capacity_not_evaluated: PSU connector inventory only (descriptive). Power, current, margins, transients and electrical safety are not evaluated.
limitations_tokens.psu_pinout_assignment_not_evaluated: No modular pinout validation, no physical cable assignment, and no electrical independence claim for split cables.
limitations_tokens.additional_storage_controllers_not_evalu: Additional SATA/RAID controllers, HBAs, splitters, port multipliers and RAID arrays are not evaluated.
limitations_tokens.sata_port_assignment_not_evaluated: SATA port count only (descriptive); physical port assignment, cable routing, BIOS conditions and exact port usage are not evaluated.
limitations_tokens.no_sata_data_port_units: No storage units requiring a motherboard SATA data port are present.
limitations_tokens.m2_slot_assignment_and_routing_not_evalu: M.2 slot assignment, PCIe lane routing/availability and performance are not evaluated.
limitations_tokens.m2_sata_topology_conditional_not_fully_e: M.2/SATA sharing is reviewed only from declared restrictions; exact conditions, the physically used slot and port assignment are not modeled.
limitations_tokens.m2_shared_resource_group_semantics_not_e: A shared M.2 resource group is declared; exclusion/availability semantics are not defined by the model.
limitations_tokens.m2_sata_disable_conditions_not_modeled: Declared M.2 SATA-port disabling is treated as a potential restriction; the exact mode/BIOS condition is not represented.
limitations_tokens.platform_chipset_not_evaluated: Chipset and platform compatibility are not evaluated.
limitations_tokens.power_delivery_not_evaluated: Power delivery and VRM adequacy are not evaluated.
limitations_tokens.psu_case_depth_not_evaluated: PSU form factor match only; exact PSU depth and case clearance are not evaluated.
limitations_tokens.psu_case_cable_clearance_not_evaluated: PSU cable routing space and clearances around the PSU are not evaluated.

recommended_actions.provide_verified_attributes: Complete and verify the missing technical attributes for the involved components.
recommended_actions.use_supported_memory_generation: Use RAM with a memory generation supported by the motherboard.
recommended_actions.use_supported_module_form_factor: Use RAM modules with a form factor supported by the motherboard.
recommended_actions.verify_attributes_or_official_support: Verify the involved attributes and check official manufacturer support/documentation.
recommended_actions.reduce_capacity_or_change_motherboard: Reduce total installed RAM capacity or use a motherboard with sufficient supported capacity.
recommended_actions.reduce_modules_or_change_motherboard: Reduce the number of modules or use a motherboard with enough memory slots.
recommended_actions.review_build_configuration: Review the build configuration to remove ambiguity.
recommended_actions.add_motherboard: Add a motherboard to the build.
recommended_actions.add_case: Add a case to the build.
recommended_actions.verify_physical_compatibility: Verify physical compatibility using specific product documentation.
recommended_actions.verify_specific_mounting_documentation: Verify specific model and mounting documentation; proprietary formats cannot be confirmed automatically.
recommended_actions.use_supported_case_or_motherboard: Use a case that supports the motherboard form factor, or a compatible motherboard/case combination.
recommended_actions.use_shorter_gpu_or_larger_case: Use a shorter GPU or a case with enough GPU clearance.
recommended_actions.use_socket_compatible_cooler: Use a CPU cooler that supports the CPU socket.
recommended_actions.add_cpu_cooler: Add a CPU cooler to evaluate socket compatibility.
recommended_actions.add_or_identify_cpu_cooler: Add or identify a CPU cooler (set cooler type) to evaluate CPU cooling compatibility.
recommended_actions.verify_radiator_mounting_documentation: Verify radiator size, mounting positions, and physical clearance using manufacturer documentation.
recommended_actions.use_shorter_cooler_or_larger_case: Use a shorter air cooler or a case with enough CPU cooler clearance.
recommended_actions.verify_complete_m2_slot_inventory_and_ph: Verify the motherboard's complete physical M.2 slot inventory and the drive's keying, length, and protocol.
recommended_actions.verify_storage_and_slot_attributes: Verify storage and motherboard M.2 slot attributes with manufacturer evidence.
recommended_actions.verify_physical_slot_compatibility: Verify physical M.2 slot compatibility (keying, length, protocol) using manufacturer documentation.
recommended_actions.provide_verified_m2_slots: Provide verified M.2 slot inventory for the motherboard.
recommended_actions.provide_verified_storage_attributes: Provide verified storage attributes (form factor, interface, command set, keying, length).
recommended_actions.use_documented_compatible_slot_or_storag: Use a documented compatible M.2 slot or a storage device that matches the documented slot.
recommended_actions.use_larger_case_or_remove_units: The declared bay capacity is insufficient for the units in this build; use a case with sufficient declared capacity or remove units. Adapters are not assumed.
recommended_actions.provide_verified_bay_counts: Provide verified 2.5"/3.5" bay count information for the case.
recommended_actions.verify_bay_capacity_and_unit_form_factor: Verify case bay capacity and storage unit form factors.
recommended_actions.verify_complete_psu_cable_inventory: Verify the complete physical PSU cable/connector inventory and evidence.
recommended_actions.verify_psu_connectors_and_inventory: Verify the declared connector requirements and the PSU cable inventory using manufacturer documentation.
recommended_actions.provide_verified_psu_cable_inventory: Provide a verified PSU cable/connector inventory.
recommended_actions.select_single_psu: Select a single PSU for connector-inventory evaluation.
recommended_actions.provide_verified_sata_port_count: Provide the verified integrated SATA port count for the motherboard.
recommended_actions.verify_additional_sata_controllers_and_p: Verify whether additional SATA controllers/ports exist; the declared integrated port count alone does not prove global incompatibility.
recommended_actions.verify_sata_port_data: Verify the integrated SATA port count/data with manufacturer documentation.
recommended_actions.verify_m2_sata_topology_in_manual: Check the motherboard manual for M.2/SATA port sharing and the exact slot/port configuration used.
recommended_actions.verify_m2_slot_inventory_and_sata_topolo: Verify the complete M.2 slot inventory and SATA-port sharing/conditional disabling in the motherboard manual.
recommended_actions.verify_storage_profile_data: Verify the storage profile attributes and resolve contradictory data with manufacturer documentation.
recommended_actions.use_psu_with_sufficient_declared_connect: Use a PSU whose declared complete cable inventory covers the required connector types/quantities, or adjust the requirements.
recommended_actions.provide_verified_cpu_mb_sockets: Provide verified CPU and motherboard socket designations.
recommended_actions.verify_cpu_motherboard_socket: Verify the declared CPU and motherboard sockets against manufacturer documentation; chipset, BIOS and power delivery still need checking.
recommended_actions.use_supported_psu_or_case: Use a case that supports the PSU form factor, or a compatible PSU/case combination.

build.empty: The build has no components, so compatibility cannot be evaluated.
build.ambiguous_motherboard: The build contains {count} motherboards. The affected relations require an unambiguous configuration.
build.ambiguous_case: The build contains {count} cases. The affected relations require an unambiguous configuration.
build.ambiguous_cpu: The build contains {count} CPUs. The affected relations require an unambiguous configuration.
build.ambiguous_cpu_cooler: The build contains {count} CPU cooler candidates. The affected relations require an unambiguous configuration.

ram_mb.motherboard_missing: RAM is present, but no motherboard is available to evaluate RAM/motherboard compatibility.

memory_generation.compatible: RAM memory generation ({generation}) is supported by the motherboard, based on verified attributes.
memory_generation.incompatible: RAM memory generation ({generation}) is not supported by the motherboard (supported: {supported}).
memory_generation.requires_verification: RAM memory generation ({generation}) versus motherboard support ({supported}) requires verification. Apparent conflict: {apparent_conflict}.
memory_generation.insufficient_data: Insufficient data to compare RAM memory generation with motherboard support.

module_form_factor.compatible: RAM module form factor ({form_factor}) is supported by the motherboard, based on verified attributes.
module_form_factor.incompatible: RAM module form factor ({form_factor}) is not supported by the motherboard (supported: {supported}).
module_form_factor.requires_verification: RAM module form factor ({form_factor}) versus motherboard support ({supported}) requires verification. Apparent conflict: {apparent_conflict}.
module_form_factor.insufficient_data: Insufficient data to compare RAM module form factor with motherboard support.

max_capacity.compatible: Total RAM capacity ({total_capacity_gb} GB) is within the motherboard maximum ({max_memory_capacity_gb} GB), based on verified attributes.
max_capacity.incompatible: Total RAM capacity ({total_capacity_gb} GB) exceeds the motherboard maximum ({max_memory_capacity_gb} GB).
max_capacity.requires_verification: Total RAM capacity ({total_capacity_gb} GB) versus motherboard maximum ({max_memory_capacity_gb} GB) requires verification. Apparent conflict: {apparent_conflict}.
max_capacity.insufficient_data: Insufficient data to compare total RAM capacity with the motherboard maximum. RAM components in build: {ram_count}; missing components: {missing_ram_components}.

module_slots.compatible: Total RAM modules ({total_module_count}) fit within motherboard memory slots ({memory_slot_count}), based on verified attributes.
module_slots.incompatible: Total RAM modules ({total_module_count}) exceed motherboard memory slots ({memory_slot_count}).
module_slots.requires_verification: Total RAM modules ({total_module_count}) versus motherboard memory slots ({memory_slot_count}) requires verification. Apparent conflict: {apparent_conflict}.
module_slots.insufficient_data: Insufficient data to compare total RAM modules with motherboard memory slots. RAM components in build: {ram_count}; missing components: {missing_ram_components}.

mb_case.case_missing: A motherboard is present, but no case is available to evaluate motherboard/case compatibility.

form_factor.compatible: Motherboard form factor ({form_factor}) is supported by the case, based on verified attributes.
form_factor.incompatible: Motherboard form factor ({form_factor}) is not supported by the case (supported: {supported}).
form_factor.requires_verification: Motherboard form factor ({form_factor}) versus case support ({supported}) requires verification. Apparent conflict: {apparent_conflict}. Reason: {reason}.
form_factor.insufficient_data: Insufficient data to compare motherboard form factor with case support.

gpu_case.case_missing: A GPU is present, but no case is available to evaluate GPU/case length compatibility.

max_length.compatible: GPU length ({card_length_mm} mm) is within the case maximum GPU length ({max_gpu_length_mm} mm), based on verified attributes. Length only; other physical dimensions are not evaluated.
max_length.incompatible: GPU length ({card_length_mm} mm) exceeds the case maximum GPU length ({max_gpu_length_mm} mm).
max_length.requires_verification: GPU length ({card_length_mm} mm) versus case maximum GPU length ({max_gpu_length_mm} mm) requires verification. Apparent conflict: {apparent_conflict}. Length only.
max_length.insufficient_data: Insufficient data to compare GPU length with case maximum GPU length.

cpu_cooling.cooler_missing: A CPU is present, but no CPU cooler is available to evaluate CPU/cooling socket compatibility.
cpu_cooling.cpu_cooler_missing: A CPU is present, but no CPU cooler candidate/type is identified to evaluate CPU/cooling socket compatibility.

socket_support.compatible: CPU socket ({socket_designation}) is supported by the CPU cooler mounting, based on verified attributes. Thermal capacity and full mounting details are not evaluated.
socket_support.incompatible: CPU socket ({socket_designation}) is not supported by the CPU cooler (supported: {supported}).
socket_support.requires_verification: CPU socket ({socket_designation}) versus CPU cooler support ({supported}) requires verification. Apparent conflict: {apparent_conflict}.
socket_support.insufficient_data: Insufficient data to compare CPU socket with CPU cooler socket support.

cooling_case.case_missing: A CPU-relevant cooler is present, but no case is available to evaluate cooling/case physical compatibility.
cooling_case.liquid_out_of_scope: Liquid CPU cooling type ({cooler_type}) radiator/mounting compatibility is outside the current scope and cannot be confirmed by air-cooler height.

air_cooler_height.compatible: Air CPU cooler height ({cooler_height_mm} mm) is within the case maximum CPU cooler height ({max_cpu_cooler_height_mm} mm), based on verified attributes. Height only; other mounting clearances are not evaluated.
air_cooler_height.incompatible: Air CPU cooler height ({cooler_height_mm} mm) exceeds the case maximum CPU cooler height ({max_cpu_cooler_height_mm} mm).
air_cooler_height.requires_verification: Air CPU cooler height ({cooler_height_mm} mm) versus case maximum CPU cooler height ({max_cpu_cooler_height_mm} mm) requires verification. Apparent conflict: {apparent_conflict}. Height only.
air_cooler_height.insufficient_data: Insufficient data to compare air CPU cooler height with case maximum CPU cooler height.

storage_m2.motherboard_missing: A storage unit is present, but no motherboard is available to evaluate M.2 compatibility.
storage_m2.slots_absent: No declared M.2 slot inventory is available for the motherboard. This does not prove the motherboard has no M.2 slots.

fit.compatible: The M.2 storage unit ({storage_id}) has at least one declared slot that documents the required protocol, keying and length. Candidate slots: {candidate_slots}. This is not a slot assignment; M.2/SATA port sharing is evaluated separately; physical assignment, conditional disabling, PCIe lane availability and performance are not evaluated.
fit.incompatible: No documented slot satisfies the verified protocol/keying/length requirements for storage unit {storage_id} (slots checked: {slot_ids}).
fit.requires_verification: The M.2 storage unit ({storage_id}) requires verification: {reason}.
fit.insufficient_data: Insufficient verified data to evaluate M.2 physical/protocol fit for storage unit {storage_id}.

storage_m2.slots_empty: The declared M.2 slot inventory is empty. This does not prove the motherboard has no physical M.2 slots.
storage_m2.slots_empty_complete: The complete declared M.2 slot inventory contains no M.2 slots.

storage_case.case_missing: A storage unit is present, but no case is available to evaluate bay capacity.

bay_2_5_capacity.compatible: 2.5-inch storage units ({units}, possible additional: {possible_units}) fit within the declared total 2.5-inch bay capacity ({bays}). Capacity dimension only; free space and adapters are not evaluated.
bay_2_5_capacity.incompatible: 2.5-inch storage units ({units}) exceed the declared total 2.5-inch bay capacity ({bays}).
bay_2_5_capacity.requires_verification: Bay capacity comparison requires verification: {reason} (confirmed: {units}, possible additional: {possible_units}, declared bays: {bays}).
bay_2_5_capacity.insufficient_data: Insufficient verified data to compare storage units with the declared bay capacity (confirmed: {units}, possible additional: {possible_units}).

bay_3_5_capacity.compatible: 3.5-inch storage units ({units}, possible additional: {possible_units}) fit within the declared total 3.5-inch bay capacity ({bays}). Capacity dimension only; free space and adapters are not evaluated.
bay_3_5_capacity.incompatible: 3.5-inch storage units ({units}) exceed the declared total 3.5-inch bay capacity ({bays}).
bay_3_5_capacity.requires_verification: Bay capacity comparison requires verification: {reason} (confirmed: {units}, possible additional: {possible_units}, declared bays: {bays}).
bay_3_5_capacity.insufficient_data: Insufficient verified data to compare storage units with the declared bay capacity (confirmed: {units}, possible additional: {possible_units}).

psu_connectors.ambiguous_psu: Multiple PSUs are present; PSU connector inventory evaluation requires a single PSU.

psu_mb.requirements_missing: Motherboard power-connector requirements are missing; PSU connector availability cannot be evaluated for the motherboard.
psu_mb.psu_inventory_missing: PSU cable inventory is missing; motherboard power-connector availability cannot be evaluated.
psu_mb.requirements_empty: No motherboard power-connector requirements are declared.
psu_mb.optional_only: Only optional motherboard power connectors are declared; no required connector shortage was found in the declared PSU inventory (descriptive only).

connector_availability.compatible: Declared PSU connector inventory provides the motherboard's required connector types/quantities (descriptive inventory only; no electrical validation).

psu_mb.requires_verification: Motherboard PSU connector availability requires verification: {reason}.
psu_mb.insufficient_declared_inventory: The declared PSU inventory does not show enough connectors for the motherboard's required types/quantities, but inventory exhaustiveness is not demonstrated: {reason}.
psu_mb.insufficient_complete_inventory: The complete declared cable inventory included with this PSU does not contain enough {missing} connectors for the stated requirements. Scope-limited to the declared complete inventory; electrical compatibility is not evaluated.

psu_gpu.requirements_missing: GPU power-connector requirements are missing; PSU connector availability cannot be evaluated for the GPU.
psu_gpu.psu_inventory_missing: PSU cable inventory is missing; GPU power-connector availability cannot be evaluated.
psu_gpu.requirements_empty: No GPU power-connector requirements are declared.
psu_gpu.optional_only: Only optional GPU power connectors are declared; no required connector shortage was found in the declared PSU inventory (descriptive only).

connector_availability.compatible: Declared PSU connector inventory provides the GPU's required connector types/quantities (descriptive inventory only; no electrical validation).

psu_gpu.requires_verification: GPU PSU connector availability requires verification: {reason}.

reasons.other_not_confirmable: The "Other" form factor cannot be automatically confirmed as compatible.
reasons.proprietary_requires_specific_documentat: Proprietary mounting requires specific model and mounting documentation.
reasons.collection_exhaustiveness_not_demonstrat: The declared M.2 slot inventory has not been shown to include every physical slot on the motherboard. Check complete documentation before concluding incompatibility
reasons.storage_or_slot_data_not_verified: Storage or M.2 slot data is not sufficiently verified
reasons.keying_or_mode_or_length_not_demonstrate: Physical keying, protocol mode, or length compatibility is not demonstrated by the available data
reasons.capacity_data_not_verified: Declared bay capacity or unit form-factor data is not sufficiently verified
reasons.inventory_exhaustiveness_not_demonstrate: The declared PSU cable inventory has not been shown to include every physical cable/connector supplied. Missing declared connectors do not prove incompatibility.
reasons.approved_adapter_not_unequivocally_valid: A manufacturer-approved adapter is declared, but its PSU model approval cannot be unequivocally validated from available component identity.
reasons.third_party_adapter_not_counted: A third-party adapter is declared and is not counted as a confirmed native/approved connector source.
reasons.unknown_assembly_not_counted: An unknown cable assembly is declared and is not counted as a confirmed connector source.
reasons.requirements_or_inventory_not_verified: Power requirements or PSU cable inventory are not sufficiently verified.
reasons.storage_units_undetermined: One or more storage units lack a determined form factor/interface/command set, so SATA data-port demand cannot be fully counted.
reasons.additional_sata_controllers_or_ports_not: The declared integrated SATA port count is lower than the demand, but additional controllers, ports, splitters or alternate paths are not modeled and cannot be excluded.
reasons.sata_port_data_not_verified: Declared SATA port data or storage unit data is not sufficiently verified.
reasons.m2_slot_may_disable_sata_ports: One or more candidate M.2 slots declare that they may disable specific SATA ports. The exact condition, physical slot used and port assignment are not modeled.
reasons.m2_slot_assignment_or_attributes_unknown: The physical M.2 slot used or the unit keying/length/protocol is unknown, so SATA-port impact cannot be determined.
reasons.shared_resource_group_semantics_not_eval: A shared M.2 resource group is declared, but the current model does not define exclusion/availability semantics for it.
reasons.m2_slot_data_not_verified: The M.2 slot inventory or its per-slot evidence is not sufficiently verified.
reasons.m2_slot_inventory_exhaustiveness_not_dem: The declared M.2 slot inventory has not been shown to include every physical slot/restriction. Absence of a declared SATA restriction does not prove compatibility.
reasons.storage_data_contradictory: Storage attributes contradict each other (interface/command set), so connectivity demand cannot be determined.
reasons.bay_demand_undetermined: One or more storage units could need a bay of the affected size, but their form factor is not sufficiently verified.
reasons.socket_match_pending_platform: The declared CPU and motherboard sockets match, but chipset, BIOS/firmware, power delivery and platform generation have not been evaluated
reasons.socket_mismatch_unresolved: The declared CPU and motherboard sockets differ; no equivalence between different socket designations is demonstrated, and this is not a proven incompatibility
reasons.socket_not_verified: At least one declared socket designation is not verified
reasons.socket_low_confidence: At least one declared socket designation has insufficient confidence
reasons.socket_not_resolvable: A declared socket value cannot be resolved to a concrete socket
reasons.attributes_not_verified: One or more compared attributes are not sufficiently verified.
reasons.sfx_sfxl_requires_manual_check: SFX and SFX-L share mounting but differ in depth; case depth is not modeled, so fit must be checked in the case manual.

psu_evidence.belongs_to_same_physical_cable: Both ends belong to the same physical cable assembly.
psu_evidence.split_electrical_limitation: Electrical safety, current sharing, and independent feeding of split-cable ends are not evaluated.
psu_evidence.not_counted_confirmed: Not counted as a confirmed native/approved connector.
psu_evidence.s7_correspondence_note: The adapter declares approval for {approved_model}, but the application cannot verify that this approval unambiguously applies to the PSU recorded as {psu_label}. The adapter is not counted as a confirmed connector. Approval reference: {approval_reference} (declared, not authenticated).
psu_evidence.modular_note: The PSU-side connector identifier belongs to this PSU and is not treated as a universal modular standard; pinout is not validated.

compatibility.storage_dimensions_note: M.2 physical fit, SATA data-port availability, M.2/SATA port sharing and case bay capacity are independent dimensions; one does not imply the others. No physical slot or port assignment is performed.

compatibility.completeness_note_unknown: It has not been shown that the inventory includes every item; absence of an element does not prove it does not exist.
